description: Fires right after the opponent drops a stone into column 4 (one right of centre) that lands on the bottom row, i.e. column 4 was empty. It also fires, more weakly, when the opponent's stone lands on row 1 of column 4 on top of their own earlier stone, once the game has at least about 8 stones. Stones on top of my stone in column 4, or higher in the column, do not fire.
effect: Small: when strongly active it shifts the model toward column 3 (about +4 to +9 points vs. turning it off) and slightly away from stacking on column 4.
notes: Layer-0 unit. H1 (last move col 4 at row 0): F1 0.80, precision 1.0. Adding row-1-on-own-stone with ply>=12: F1 0.90; ply>=8: F1 0.943 (P 0.968, R 0.920), AUROC 0.959, sim share 0.55. Row-1 case is borderline (acts 2-4) and depends on how long ago the earlier col-4 stone was played; rare misses include row 1 on my stone late in the game. Neighbour column heights had no effect. Strength rises with earlier moves in cols 0-1, falls with moves in cols 5-6.
